mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (store_id, order_id, place_id, payment_amount, discount_amount) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{orderId}, #{placeId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT PAY.payment_id, PAY.payment_amount, PAY.discount_amount, PAY.created_at, PLACE.place_name, -- 메뉴 이름과 수량을 "이름 수량" 형태로 연결하여 하나의 문자열로 합침 GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT(M.menu_name, ' ', OM.order_item_quantity) SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS menu_names FROM payments PAY INNER JOIN places PLACE ON PAY.place_id = PLACE.place_id INNER JOIN orders O ON PAY.order_id = O.order_id INNER JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id INNER JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE PAY.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY PAY.payment_id;
